findings.title: Admin IDOR (bb21e4f3b) — heal re-attacked, sentinel exercises the real contract

findings.title: Loyalty QR signing (59a5dc84f) — JWT-HMAC heal real, nonce table race-safe
findings.evidence: Sentinel tests/Feature/Sentinels/LoyaltyQrSigningSentinelTest passes during this audit. Critical adversarial vectors checked: (1) plaintext QR token: rejected with error_code qr_legacy_rejected when feature flag forbids — flag-controlled rollback path exists, (2) TTL expiry: 300s + 30s leeway documented, (3) replay defense: INSERT-then-catch-QueryException on UNIQUE — no TOCTOU pre-SELECT window. Service file app/Services/Loyalty/LoyaltyQrSigner.php confirms the HMAC payload includes nonce+exp+cust+code. Heal cuts the screenshot/OCR exploit window from 5 min cosmetic to <5 min cryptographic plus replay-blocked.
findings.re_attack_outcome: PASS — closes the cross-surface fraud window

findings.title: Idempotency middleware — config drift: NEW POS loyalty redeem route absent from required_routes
findings.evidence: Run of full Feature suite during audit caught it: 'Routes with `idempotency` middleware NOT in config(idempotency.required_routes): api/admin/pos-order/{order}/redeem-loyalty'. The middleware silently no-ops when the URI is not in required_routes (back-compat opt-in design). Exploit chain: cashier double-taps Redeem CTA on slow network -> client retry with same Idempotency-Key -> server has no key dedupe -> double-debit loyalty points balance. Magnitude: low ($X loyalty points / customer / event) but visible per LCS-S-002 commit body which fixed the sister route /api/frontend/loyalty/redeem with the same pattern.
findings.re_attack_outcome: OPEN — sentinel did its job, but the heal is not in the session. Recommended 1-line config fix in V1.0.X follow-up.
findings.production_impact_v1: Low — POS Loyalty Redeem UI is new in V1; cashier flow includes confirmation modal; double-tap window narrow.
